# Hit Your Mark Travel — Bespoke Luxury Journeys

Official homepage: https://www.hymtravel.com/
Canonical HTML: https://www.hymtravel.com/
AI navigation: https://www.hymtravel.com/llms.txt

Hit Your Mark Travel is a single-advisor luxury travel planning business led by Mark Sole. Based in Bend, Oregon and serving US clients, HYMT designs personalized journeys, from destination selection and accommodations to activities and logistics. It is not an online booking engine.

## How planning works

1. Dream: Share your destinations, occasion, interests and priorities.
2. Aim: Work with Mark to narrow down suitable places, stays, guides and experiences.
3. Book: Finalize reservations and logistical details before departure.

The official inquiry forms require the visitor's action. No public API for bookings or submitting visitor details is provided.
